identification: Mixed lot of about 28 old bottles: crown-seal soft drink bottles (Phillips & Son Devonport embossed), Tasmanian bottles (Abbotts, Jones & Co, Port Huon Fruit Juices, Cascade, Tasma, Bakers Milk) and mainland bottles (Chas Ogg Melbourne, Champions Vinegar, Golden Circle, Mildara, John Sutherland). Mostly common 20th century bottles; dirty, no obvious chips.
